methods.label: Combine fractions and substitute
methods.explanation: Using a common denominator gives \(\frac{2+(x-2)}{x^2-4}=\frac{x}{x^2-4}\). When \(x=4\), its value is \(\frac{4}{12}=\frac{1}{3}\).
methods.levelReason: Factoring a difference of squares and adding rational expressions are Grade 8 procedures; substitution uses earlier algebra.
